fusions.name: Lukewarm Bead
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of warm water that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Huddled Flurry
fusions.desc: Beats the air in a ring, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%). It holds 3 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Huddle Warmth
fusions.desc: Raises a warm hollow where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Afterglow
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
